title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Annual Price List by Equipment Type
content:
## Price per covered unit, by equipment type and tier (USD per year)

The annual price of a Preventive Maintenance Agreements schedule is priced unit by unit from this list. A figure of 0 means that equipment type cannot be scheduled under that tier.

| Equipment type | Filter & Belt Service Plan | Inspection Agreement | Preventive Maintenance Agreement | Labor Coverage Agreement | Full Coverage Agreement | Comprehensive Performance Agreement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rooftop unit | 285 | 240 | 690 | 1180 | 1890 | 2650 |
| Split system | 165 | 150 | 410 | 690 | 1050 | 1480 |
| Heat pump | 175 | 160 | 460 | 760 | 1180 | 1620 |
| VRF system | 240 | 320 | 980 | 1720 | 2650 | 3700 |
| Air handler | 320 | 300 | 820 | 1350 | 1980 | 2750 |
| Chiller | 0 | 1450 | 6400 | 11200 | 17800 | 24500 |
| Boiler | 0 | 620 | 1850 | 3150 | 4900 | 6800 |
| Cooling tower | 0 | 540 | 2250 | 3600 | 5400 | 7200 |
| Pump | 0 | 110 | 260 | 420 | 640 | 880 |
| Exhaust fan | 60 | 70 | 150 | 210 | 290 | 360 |
| Makeup air unit | 260 | 260 | 640 | 1050 | 1620 | 2250 |
| Computer room unit | 310 | 380 | 1250 | 2150 | 3400 | 4650 |

## Price floors, portfolio discount, bundle credit and mid-term change figures

| Tier | Floor on the annual agreement price after all discounts (USD) | Multi-site discount on the annual price (percent) | Number of the owner's agreements in active or pending renewal status, this one included, needed for the multi-site discount | Annual credit when the site holds an active Building Automation Service Plan that provides alarm monitoring (USD) | Basis on which a mid-term equipment addition or removal is prorated | Minimum charge for a mid-term equipment addition (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Filter & Belt Service Plan | 1140 | 3 | 3 | 0 | monthly | 60 |
| Inspection Agreement | 960 | 3 | 3 | 0 | monthly | 75 |
| Preventive Maintenance Agreement | 1800 | 5 | 3 | 0 | monthly | 120 |
| Labor Coverage Agreement | 3600 | 5 | 3 | 350 | monthly | 180 |
| Full Coverage Agreement | 6000 | 7 | 3 | 600 | daily | 250 |
| Comprehensive Performance Agreement | 18000 | 8 | 2 | 900 | daily | 400 |

### List notes

- Chillers, boilers, cooling towers and pumps carry a price of 0 under the Filter & Belt Service Plan, so none of those types can be scheduled under that tier.
- The multi-site threshold is 3 agreements at every tier except the Comprehensive Performance Agreement, where it is 2; the discount rises from 3 percent at the two entry tiers to 5, 5, 7 and 8 percent.
- The building automation bundle credit is 0 at the three lower tiers and 350, 600 and 900 USD at the three upper tiers.
- Mid-term changes are prorated monthly at the four lower tiers and daily at the Full Coverage Agreement and the Comprehensive Performance Agreement; the minimum charge for an addition runs from 60 USD to 400 USD.
